thread:
sophia-sales: ACME POC hitting 401 when they include X-Redwood-Org header after key rotation. Without the header same secret sometimes works. Can we triage quickly?

kevin-se: Paste sanitized curl + last 8 of key id pls.

sophia-sales: curl:
```
curl -s -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx-7e2b9f01\" \
  -H \"X-Redwood-Org: acme-enterprise\" \
  -H \"X-Redwood-Project: demo\" \
  -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'
```
Key suffix: 7e2b9f01

mira-platform: Lookup: sk-xxxx-7e2b9f01 = user-scoped key created under a personal workspace, not org-bound. Auth checks recently tightened: authproxy now rejects user keys when X-Redwood-Org header is present.

kevin-se: That explains why it works without header. Two remediations: 1) create an org-scoped API key in their Console and rotate, or 2) (temporary) remove X-Redwood-Org header. Recommend option 1.

sophia-sales: They also see 403 on /v1/embeddings after rotation.

mira-platform: If the key was created with a preset that excludes embeddings you'll get 403 insufficient_scope. Org keys can be scoped to embeddings/generate/admin.

auth-bot: authproxy v5.1.0 deployed -> org-binding enforcement enabled

ops-bot: creating ephemeral org key for demo call (24h expiry)... done: sk-org-temp-4c9a (expires in 24h)

kevin-se: I validated sk-org-temp-4c9a against both endpoints with correct headers; both return 200. I'll share via secure channel during the call.

sophia-sales: Scheduling 30m with customer. Advice to pass along: store keys server-side (K8s secret / Vault), rotate via CI, revoke old secrets after validation, watch Console for rate/usage to avoid 429s.

mira-platform: Also warn about project slug exact-match: if key is project-scoped to `demo-v2` but they send `demo` you'll see project_mismatch. Case-sensitive.

sophia-sales: Post-call: they switched to a new org key from their Console and rolled atomically. Both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings now 200. Customer asked for a brief blurb on key scoping best-practices; I'll follow up. Closing unless more issues.
